subject.title: docs(secrets): generate secretref reference docs from target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation branch should remain the canonical implementation path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44289?
rationale: The requested work remains valid, but this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 overlap, both currently conflict with main, and choosing between repairing this branch or refreshing the stronger sibling is a maintainer ownership decision.

options.title: Refresh stronger sibling
options.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix if maintainers prefer its formatter/test shape.

options.title: Repair this PR
options.body: Ask this branch to derive annotations from matrix metadata, add current-head drift/regeneration proof, and resolve conflicts before maintainer review.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Pause or close both competing branches and ask for one narrow replacement if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh stronger sibling
recommendation.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix if maintainers prefer its formatter/test shape.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the SecretRef docs and script surfaces and is the best available routing owner for choosing the canonical branch.
